    def euclidean_distance(x1, y1, x2, y2):
        return sqrt((x2 - x1)**2 + (y2 - y1)**2)
    
    def effective_velocity(vx, vy, wx, wy):
        return sqrt((vx + wx)**2 + (vy + wy)**2)
    
    def time_to_reach_target(x1, y1, x2, y2, vx, vy, wx, wy):
        dx = x2 - x1
        dy = y2 - y1
        dvx = vx + wx
        dvy = vy + wy
        if dvx == 0 and dvy == 0:
            return float('inf')
        return abs(dx * dvy - dy * dvx) / effective_velocity(dvx, dvy, wx, wy)
    
    dt = 1e-6
    left, right = 0, max(euclidean_distance(x1, y1, x2, y2), t * vmax)
    while right - left > dt:
        mid = (left + right) / 2
        x, y = x1, y1
        vx, vy = 0, 0
        for i in range(t):
            wx, wy = winds[i][0], winds[i][1]
            dvx = vx + wx
            dvy = vy + wy
